formula: each day every listed track is ranked against the rest of the market. 55% where it ranks for dj support, 15% where it ranks for support gained this week, 20% its best beatport chart tier in the last two weeks, 10% spotify editorial adds in the last four weeks. smoothed over a few days and scaled to 5-250 points. a track with no dj support yet is priced on its chart tier and editorial adds alone.
